packageRules.description: .github/workflows/release.yml is generated by dist and `dist plan` fails when it drifts; its action pins live in dist-workspace.toml under github-action-commits

packet-dissector, packet-dissector-core, packet-dissector-pcap, and packet-dissector-test-alloc are published in lockstep from the same repo; bumping only one alone breaks the build because dsct depends on more than one directly
gpui-kit pins an exact GPUI snapshot (gpui-pre-*); update the GUI's GPUI crates together, keeping gpui-pre-macos at the version gpui-kit pins
